vous-church-miami-fl.assessment: Vous Church is an ARC (Association of Related Churches) congregation — a seeker-sensitive church planting network. Miami-based ARC church targeting young adults. Celebrity-adjacent culture.

score_notes.christology: Website describes Jesus as 'message' but provides no formal creedal statement; Trinity and deity of Christ not explicitly affirmed on public pages.
score_notes.scripture: No doctrinal statement on inerrancy; Scripture authority not articulated on public site.
score_notes.gender: Rich AND DawnCheré Wilkerson listed as 'lead pastors' (husband-wife co-pastor model) per vouschurch.com homepage. Per Church Clarity, DawnCheré preaches Sunday services solo. Egalitarian.
score_notes.leadership: Husband-wife lead-pastor structure with no visible elder plurality or accountability; celebrity-pastor culture (Wilkerson officiated Kim Kardashian/Kanye West wedding).
score_notes.soteriology: 'Bring those far from God close to him' framing; no explicit sola fide or substitutionary atonement statement.
score_notes.cultural: Youth/celebrity-oriented Miami aesthetic; no explicit DEI/CRT language but also no conservative biblical markers.
score_notes.preaching: Topical, seeker-sensitive, young-adult/celebrity-oriented content rather than expository.
score_notes.mission: Mission stated ('bring those far from God close'); generic, no Great Commission or missions-giving specifics on homepage.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: No men's ministry visible on homepage navigation.
score_notes.denominational: Affiliated with ARC (Association of Related Churches) — church-planting network with coaching rather than confessional accountability; spun out of Trinity Church Miami.

vous-church-miami-fl.gender_detail: Husband-wife co-lead-pastor model; DawnCheré Wilkerson preaches Sunday services (per Church Clarity). Egalitarian.

voyage-church-montreal-montreal-quebec.assessment: Member of the Pillar Network. Network values: church planting + church revitalization, expositional preaching, complementarian polity, SBC-cooperative, Reformed-leaning soteriology.
